title: Eureka! Archimedes and the fake crown
description:
King Hiero II suspected fraud: had his goldsmith mixed silver into the golden crown? Legend says Archimedes found the answer in his bath – using density. Centuries later, Galileo had an even better idea.

One true story from the history of math – every day.
Created with AI assistance (animation and voice); facts from the sources listed.

Sources:
· Vitruv, De architectura IX, Einleitung 9–12
· Galilei, La Bilancetta (1586)
· Chris Rorres, Archimedes – The Golden Crown (NYU)
